title: Transcriptome sequencing reveals the roles of transcription factors in modulating genotype by nitrogen interaction in maize
genotypes: Zheng58; Chang7-2 (inbred parents of hybrid Zhengdan958; both described as N-efficient; Chang7-2 more N-responsive)
stage_age: flowering (sampled when 80% of plants in the plot had flowered)
growth_system: field; Shangzhuang experimental station, China Agricultural University, Beijing; 2011 (single season); single-row plots, 7 replications
N_treatments: NN 450 kg/ha urea (general agronomic rate, as stated) vs LN no N fertilizer (fields without N fertilizer in the preceding 2 years)
timepoints_duration: season-long N treatment; single sampling at flowering
bio_reps: 2 per genotype x N (each a pool of ear leaves from 4 plants of one plot replicate)
platform_layout: Illumina HiSeq 2000, PE100 (insert ~300 bp), Berry Genomics
key_finding: 96 G x N interaction genes enriched for TFs (AP2/EREBP, WRKY); Chang7-2 transcriptome more N-responsive than Zheng58
notes: ~10.3 M clean PE reads per sample; aligned to B73 AGPv2 (TopHat2), filtered gene set 5b, edgeR (G x N at FDR<0.1); 2 of 7 field plot replicates sampled; authors note single tissue/stage/season and only 2 replicates

title: The Role of Gibberellins in Regulation of Nitrogen Uptake and Physiological Traits in Maize Responding to Nitrogen Availability
genotypes: wild type B73-329 (inbred background); zmga3ox CRISPR-Cas9 knockout (GRMZM2G036340; 34-bp frameshift deletion; GA-deficient dwarf)
stage_age: seedlings with 2 visible leaves (7 d on sand) + 2 d half-strength solution, then LN/SN; sampled 12, 60, 108 h after treatment onset
growth_system: hydroponic (modified Hoagland, 5 L boxes); growth chamber 28/22 °C, 16/8 h, 70-80% RH (conditions stated for germination step)
N_treatments: SN 2.0 mM NO3- vs LN 0.05 mM NO3- (KNO3; K in LN balanced with KCl)
other_factors: mutant zmga3ox vs WT; GA3 (1 µM) and uniconazole (2 µM) used in physiological assays but not described for RNA-seq samples
timepoints_duration: 12, 60 and 108 h after onset of LN/SN
n_libraries: 36 (computed: 2 genotypes x 2 N x 3 time points x 3 reps)
platform_layout: Illumina HiSeq 4000, PE150 (NEBNext Ultra RNA Library Prep)
other_omics: GA quantification (HPLC-MS/MS); 15N uptake; net NO3- flux (NMT); NR/GS activity; chlorophyll/anthocyanin; RT-qPCR
key_finding: GA-deficient zmga3ox roots had lower nitrate uptake and nitrate-transporter expression under LN and SN; N metabolism most enriched pathway
notes: No accession or data statement in the retrieved PMC text (back matter not returned; publisher page not checked); 3054 DEGs (|log2FC|>=1, FDR<0.05; edgeR WT vs mutant); TopHat2 to B73 RefGen_v3; gene names partly stripped in PMC text (mutant name taken from section headings)

title: Transcriptomic and genome-wide association study reveal long noncoding RNAs responding to nitrogen deficiency in maize
genotypes: P178 (inbred) for RNA-seq; association panel of 362 inbreds (255 used in GWAS) phenotyped under HN/LN without RNA-seq
tissue: second fully expanded leaf (from top); whole root
stage_age: 14-day-old seedlings (HN/LN duration before sampling not explicitly stated)
growth_system: hydroponic (Hoagland, 25-L buckets) after germination in quartz sand to 2 visible leaves; greenhouse 25/22 °C, 16/8 h, 200 µmol m-2 s-1, 65% RH
N_treatments: HN 4 mM KNO3 vs LN 0.04 mM KNO3
timepoints_duration: single RNA-seq sampling; qRT-PCR time course 0 h to 14 d after N treatment
n_libraries: 24 (12 lncRNA-seq + 12 small RNA-seq; each 2 N x 2 tissues x 3 reps)
platform_layout: Illumina HiSeq 2500 (Novogene); lncRNA-seq paired-end per alignment description, read length and library type NR; plus small RNA-seq
other_omics: small RNA-seq (miRNA); GWAS (MaizeSNP50, 46,108 SNPs); root phenotyping (WinRhizo); N. benthamiana transient assays
key_finding: 894 DE lncRNAs and 38 DE miRNAs under LN; LNC_002923 inhibits ZmmiR159-guided cleavage of Zm00001d015521
source_of_details: PMC full text; publisher PDF for data availability statement
notes: Data statement: 'All original data can be downloaded from the NCBI database (accession number: PRJNA661965 and PRJNA662035)'; which BioProject holds lncRNA-seq vs sRNA-seq not stated; mapped to B73 RefGen_v4 (TopHat/Cufflinks/Cuffdiff); 40 LN-responsive candidate genes from GWAS + RNA-seq integration

title: Nitrate-dependent suberization regulates cadmium uptake and accumulation in maize
tissue: root (crown roots analysed; exact RNA-seq tissue NR)
N_treatments: low vs high nitrate supply (concentrations NR in abstract)
other_factors: cadmium (Cd) exposure (whether RNA-seq samples were Cd-treated NR)
other_omics: suberin chemistry (aliphatic/aromatic); bioimaging; xylem-sap Cd analysis
key_finding: Low nitrate upregulates suberin biosynthesis genes and root suberization, restricting radial Cd transport; high nitrate increases Cd uptake
source_of_details: abstract only (no PMC full text; web search found no accession; publisher page not accessed)
notes: All design fields NR because only the abstract was available; abstract states RNA-seq of low vs high nitrate; verify design and data availability on publisher page
